name: Fishermen
overview: The Scriptures reveal fishermen as both literal and figurative figures, notably exemplified by apostles such as Simon Peter, Andrew, James, and John, who were called by Jesus while casting nets by the Sea of Galilee. Jesus' invitation to 'follow me, and I will make you fishers of men' highlights the transition from their earthly profession to a spiritual mission of gathering souls. Additionally, the prophetic imagery in Jeremiah depicts God sending fishers and hunters to gather His people from every place, underscoring the divine purpose behind the calling of fishermen as agents of God's redemptive work.
